component.name: ObserveFieldScene
component.script:
Function init() m.ButtonGroup1 = m.top.findNode("ButtonGroup1") m.ButtonGroup1.observeField("buttonSelected", "onButtonSelected") m.ButtonGroup2 = m.top.findNode("ButtonGroup2") m.ButtonGroup2.observeField("buttonSelected", "onButtonSelected") m.Target = m.top.findNode("ObserveTarget") m.Observer1 = m.top.findNode("Observer1") m.Observer1.targetNode = m.Target m.Observer1.targetField = "buttonSelected" m.Observer2 = m.top.findNode("Observer2") m.Observer2.targetNode = m.Target m.Observer2.targetField = "buttonSelected" m.ButtonGroup1.setFocus(true) End Function
Function onButtonSelected(msg) node = msg.getRoSGNode() observer = invalid if node.id = "ButtonGroup1" observer = m.Observer1 else if node.id = "ButtonGroup2" observer = m.Observer2 end if button = node.buttons[node.buttonSelected] if button = "observe" observer.observe = true else if button = "unobserve" observer.unobserve = true else if button = "observeScoped" observer.observeScoped = true else if button = "unobserveScoped" observer.unobserveScoped = true end if End Function
Function onKeyEvent(key, press) 'print "ObserveFieldScene.onKeyEvent key="; key; " press="; press if press if key = "right" and m.ButtonGroup1.isInFocusChain() print "Setting ButtonGroup2 focus" m.ButtonGroup2.setFocus(true) return true else if key = "left" and m.ButtonGroup2.isInFocusChain() print "Setting ButtonGroup1 focus" m.ButtonGroup1.setFocus(true) return true else if key = "up" and not m.Target.hasFocus() print "Setting Target focus" m.Target.setFocus(true) return true else if key = "down" and m.Target.hasFocus() print "Setting ButtonGroup1 focus" m.ButtonGroup1.setFocus(true) return true end if end if return false End Function
